comment.description: Optional text the user can provide for additional, unstructured context.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: The display name of the feedback.

feedback_id.description: Resource ID of the security feedback.

feedback_type.description: The type of feedback being submitted. Possible values: ["EXCLUDED_DETECTION"]

org_id.description:
The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee Security Feedback,
in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.

reason.description: The reason for the feedback. Possible values: ["INTERNAL_SYSTEM", "NON_RISK_CLIENT", "NAT", "PENETRATION_TEST", "OTHER"]

feedback_contexts.description: One or more attribute/value pairs for constraining the feedback.

feedback_contexts.attribute.description: The attribute the user is providing feedback about. Possible values: ["ATTRIBUTE_ENVIRONMENTS", "ATTRIBUTE_IP_ADDRESS_RANGES"]

feedback_contexts.values.description: The values of the attribute the user is providing feedback about, separated by commas.
